_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Kana ndo Player {player_id} kyeri ndu LinesOfAction.
Kyeri ndu ci '{side}', kyeri ndu kul '{other}'.
Format ndu bol: `[b1b3]` (kisa-kisa). Bol ndu tada kyeri ndu wodi, kul wodi, ko diagonally kisa ndu wodi kwana cikwana kyeri ndu kul ndu wodi. Kana ndo bol ndu kyeri ndu ci, amma ba kul ndu ci; kisa ndu kul ndu ci kana ndo kyeri ndu ci.  Kana ndo win ndu kyeri ndu ci 8-kul ndu ci.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format dǝ e2e4 (from,to coordinates) ro waljin.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kǝndodә raktin au diagonal ro waljin.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Dәn nǝm cintunzǝ tilo-a layi lan yaktin.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} bol {from} -> {to} kul ndu ci ndu kul.
